summary:
Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 tests). Nothing was committed and no existing module changed.

Deviation from spec: the parser starts with an isinstance(path_identifier, Node) guard that raises SHACLPathError. Without it, None passed as a subject acts as a wildcard in graph lookups, which the spec forbids. The guard's raise line carries # type: ignore[unreachable].

Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so the type check and formatting were not run. Line lengths are within 88 columns, and the type-ignore placement was checked by reading the code only. The unreachable ignore and the [operator] ignores on the "*" multiplication lines are the most likely to need adjustment once mypy runs.
